layout_sources: https://github.com/firefly-iii/import-configurations/blob/main/de/volksbank/stuttgart/import.json (2022: the 19 columns in this order: account name, IBAN, BIC, bank name, Buchungstag, Valutadatum, counterparty name/IBAN/BIC, Buchungstext, Verwendungszweck, Betrag, Waehrung, Saldo nach Buchung, Bemerkung, Kategorie, Steuerrelevant, Gläubiger ID, Mandatsreferenz; semicolon; d.m.Y)

https://github.com/bank2ynab/bank2ynab/blob/master/bank2ynab.conf [DE Fiducia (Volksbank, Sparda-Bank, ...)] (file name Umsaetze_<IBAN>_<yyyy.mm.dd>; the older 13-row-preamble format it describes is gone)
notes: Export of the Atruvia online banking used by Volksbanken and Raiffeisenbanken since 2022: one header row with ASCII-spelt names (Waehrung, Glaeubiger ID), the own account in the first four columns of every line, dd.mm.yyyy, a signed Betrag and "Saldo nach Buchung" (the balance after each line) in German number format with dot thousands, semicolons, no quotes. Windows-1252, CRLF and newest-first order assumed (not confirmed). Opening = the oldest line's balance less its amount; closing = the newest line's balance.
